name: agentic-wallet
description: Agentic Wallet - copiloto financiero personal local-first

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,panel "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web" "npm run dev --workspace=panel"
scripts.dev:panel: concurrently -n server,panel "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=panel"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=panel && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.deploy:docs: npm run build:docs && firebase deploy --only hosting
